name: Wisdom Tales
tagline: Explore the depths of proverbs and parables in modern life.
description: Old wisdom for everyday life. Dig into proverbs, act out parables, and talk honestly about how wisdom shapes friendships, words, and choices.

cards.title: A Soft Answer
cards.prompt: Describe a time a gentle reply calmed a situation, or a harsh one made it worse.
cards.body: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

cards.title: Iron Sharpens Iron
cards.prompt: Name a friend who makes you better and say how.
cards.body: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

cards.title: A Friend at All Times
cards.prompt: Explain this verse to the group using only 5 words.
cards.body: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

cards.prompt: What's a proverb or saying you grew up hearing from family?
Which friend sharpens you the most, and how?
When is it hardest for you to give a soft answer?

cards.title: Soft Answer
cards.prompt: Someone in the group says a pretend rude comment. Reply with a kind, calm answer.

cards.title: Proverb Remix
cards.prompt: Turn a Bible proverb into a short, encouraging text for a friend and read it aloud.

cards.title: Parable Charades
cards.prompt: Act out parables: the Good Samaritan, the Prodigal Son, the Lost Sheep, the Sower, the Mustard Seed.
cards.instruction: No talking. The team guesses. Most correct wins.

cards.title: Finish the Proverb
cards.prompt: The host reads the first half of a proverb and teams finish it: 'A soft answer...', 'Iron sharpeneth iron...', 'Pride goeth before...', 'Trust in the LORD...'
cards.instruction: First team to finish correctly scores.

cards.prompt: Share a piece of wise advice that changed you.
Tell about a time a friend's honesty helped you grow.
